summary: Cognyte Software Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, announcing a press release that it will hold a conference call on June 3, 2026, to review first quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results (quarter ending April 30, 2026). This is a routine earnings call date announcement with no special-situation elements. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K serves as a current report, but the content is purely an earnings schedule notice—not a special situation. The only action is the issuer providing advance notice of an earnings call, with no terms, recommendations, or structural details. There is no event warranting classification as a special situation.
